coprocessor: Beads Cryptographic Security Engine on Battery Pack PCM

cryptographic_primitives.algorithm: ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 with Hardware Sealed Private Key

protocol_flow.name: AUTH_INIT
protocol_flow.description: Host sends random 32-byte non-repeating cryptographic nonce

protocol_flow.name: CHALLENGE_PROCESS
protocol_flow.description: Beads signs nonce concatenated with battery serial and calibration digest

protocol_flow.name: RESPONSE_DISPATCH
protocol_flow.description: Beads returns 64-byte (r, s) ECDSA signature and certificate

protocol_flow.name: VERIFY_CERTIFICATE
protocol_flow.description: Secure Enclave verifies certificate against Apple Battery Root CA

protocol_flow.name: VERIFY_SIGNATURE
protocol_flow.description: Secure Enclave validates signature; unlocks authentic battery health telemetry
